new.n: River Bend School site (New London 1956 topo)
new.v: Coins, buttons, pencil caps, toys and slate pieces
new.st: The 1956 USGS topo map (New London 15-minute sheet) draws River Bend School here (school symbol, sec. 1 T23N R15E). No second source found yet; 6 buildings within 60 m today (it may still stand, or a newer house took its place).
new.t: Look for the level school-yard pad, a fieldstone foundation corner, lilacs and the old well; the road edge in front was the playground. Ask the landowner first.
pinev: Placed on the New London 1956 topo symbol (old-maps-over-today pass); good to about 50 m
Unconfirmed, one source
